full_details: Master Thwaite read the heads of Friday's proclamation and preached for a single turn of the glass. The Mayor's pew had halberds at the door and a new man standing behind. In the north aisle one pew was empty. A neighbour told Mistress Ansell that half the better sort had gone out of the City. You put no cross in the almanac. After dinner you walked the close and said the people who had gone were sensible, and that the boy you are writing would have to stand for the rest of it. At the table the loaf was still a penny and still a thumb short. The letter still names no day. It is still not folded, and it is still not going.
one_sentence: You stood through one turn of a sermon, and saw the pew in the north aisle.
title: Stood through one turn of the sermon
